faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria to avail this card?
faqs.a: The card is offered to both salaried and self-employed individuals aged between 21 and up to 65 years. Additionally, one needs to fulfill the income requirement of minimum Rs. 25,000 per month for salaried and ITR greater than Rs. 6 Lakh per annum for self-employed.

faqs.q: What transactions are excluded from the cashback program?
faqs.a: The card does not offer any cashback on fuel, rent, EMI, e-wallet loading and government related spends.

faqs.q: How do I apply for this credit card?
faqs.a: You can apply for this credit card via the HDFC Bank’s PayZapp app.

faqs.q: Does the card offer any UPI linked credit card benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, with the RuPay variant of the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card, you can avail 1% cashback benefit on the UPI spends.

faqs.q: Can I avail fuel surcharge waiver on this credit card?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions ranging between Rs. 400 and Rs. 5,000, up to Rs. 250 per month.

faqs.question: Is the HDFC Pixel Play Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: Yes, HDFC Bank is currently offering the Pixel Play Credit Card as a lifetime free credit card for eligible users.

faqs.question: Does the HDFC Pixel Play Credit Card support UPI?
faqs.answer: Yes, the RuPay variant of the HDFC Pixel Play Credit Card supports UPI payments and offers 1% cashback on eligible UPI spends.

faqs.question: What is the cashback rate on the HDFC Pixel Play Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers up to 5% cashback on selected merchant packs, 3% cashback on one selected shopping platform and 1% cashback on other eligible spends.

faqs.question: Does the HDFC Pixel Play Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No, the HDFC Pixel Play Credit Card does not provide complimentary domestic or international airport lounge access.

faqs.question: What is the value of 1 PIXEL CashPoint?
faqs.answer: 1 PIXEL CashPoint is equal to Rs 1.
